notes:
Content summary: The page continues a discussion of classes of splittings relative to L_i, especially those attached to a local uniformizer at the generic point s_alpha of D_alpha. A raised parenthesis refers to the associated class in m_salpha/m_salpha^2. The author says specialization is clear at points where the rational section of the stated conormal sheaf remains regular and invertible. He then proposes studying specialization of sections of the second type at the other points, by an analogous study of extensions of profinite groups, but calls this a less burning interest; the final sentence ends unfinished at car cela vient|n’est, with vient preferred and both readings doubtful. Layout and reading: two prose paragraphs, twenty principal baselines, no display, diagram or drawing; four raised insertions, three cancelled text groups and a further altered closing-parenthesis form with doubtful cancellation state, the author’s 47 above and a fine other-hand 94 below left. The whole source and both supplied halves were read once; thirty unique crops were saved and read. Existing crops were reused, without recropping, to compare the article, classes ending, scindages punctuation and the disputed absence of dans. Diplomatic cautions: preserve the nested B followed by its small point as B.|B_0 under doubt, without identifying or normalizing B. The two conormal indices differ on the page: first D_alpha comma S, later D_alpha/S. The first superscript remains r|+|vee despite the familiar conormal context; no mathematical expectation settles that stroke. The raised verb remains intervient|interviennent, its following short form p-with-raised-r|par, and the noun brin|biais|bon|bout. The subsequent elles définissent is resolved. The cancelled plus gén. doubt remains because its stop is crossed. No dans is written between the verb and the quotient, so it is absent from the draft. Both s_alpha and question have comma-shaped tails, while the final inversible has a round stop. Brulant has no visible circumflex. Uniformisant is physically divided uniformi- / sant at a line end; the running transcription joins the word. The retraced preposition remains sur|en, followed by the separately written les quels; no distinct earlier cancelled word is supplied. The q descender over the quotient and the curved leader under de deuxième type are not deletions; the leader attaches the addition before d’extensions. Completed adjudication explicitly retains the point beside nested B as B.|B_0 and the two points before the second N as ..|:. Their exact roles remain uncertain, but the visible marks are not omitted. First-reader scope of checks: this was visual transcription and comparison only; the later main-reader conditional calculation is recorded separately below. No claim about existence, uniqueness or specialization of profinite splittings has been proved or used as a mathematical certificate here. The wording’s conditions and formulas were read as written, with no theorem-based repair. H’s uncertainty around analogue was settled as a readable common word on the supplied lower half; it does not produce a lexical collation row.
Main-reader mathematical check (149095-conormal-local-generator): under the additional local effective-Cartier hypothesis I=(t) with t a non-zero-divisor, the map A/(t) to I/I², a↦at, is an isomorphism. A rational multiple of this local generator is regular and generating precisely where its coefficient is a local unit. The proof and scope are in CHECK_EVENTS.tsv. This conditional calculation does not prove the profinite specialization assertion or decide the written r-like exponent.

Blind adjudication supersedes several first-stage certainties. The opening now reads colon regarder la classes|classe, retaining the noun’s number uncertainty independently of the article. An additional root crop confirms the end of regarder outside the anonymous B003 crop. The comma after scindages is retained, and the small point after nested B is explicit as B.|B_0. D’un|d’une remains unresolved; the following uniformisant has no separately visible final e. The inserted parenthesis preserves the p-with-raised-r short form, admits intervient|interviennent and brin|biais|bon|bout, and resolves the following pronoun/verb to elles définissent. The later retraced preposition is sur|en, with les quels written separately. The conormal superscript is r|+|vee. The apparent ampersand after régulier is now a doubtful altered closing parenthesis; two actual points after de|donc|du are restored. The opening si was inspected on an additional detail crop and retained over où. The cancelled word before inserted d’un is unique|moins, and the page-end verb vient|n’est remains doubtful. All twenty-two token-different boxes were inspected; the two additional root crops address only clipping and the small parenthesis opening.

check_events.outcome: Conditional local algebra verification: suppose D is an effective Cartier divisor, so at the point in question its ideal is I=(t) in a ring A and t is a non-zero-divisor. The map A/(t)→I/I² sending the class of a to the class of at is well-defined and surjective. If at=t²b, then t(a−tb)=0, hence a=tb, proving injectivity. Thus I/I² is free of rank one locally. When D is integral, write a rational section of this line bundle as u times the local generator [t]; it extends regularly at a point exactly when u lies in the local ring of D, and is a generator there exactly when u is a unit. Its dual is likewise an invertible module. This verifies only the local conormal/generator calculation under the Cartier and integral hypotheses; it neither proves that the stated regularity assumptions imply those hypotheses nor proves specialization of profinite-group splittings. It does not decide or repair the written r-like superscript.
